decks.notes: This deck focuses on using creatures with cycling abilities to fill the graveyard quickly and cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo and speed up the process with cards like Violent Outburst. The mana base is designed to support the combo while providing access to all necessary colors for casting spells. The key strategy is to cycle through your deck efficiently, control the board with disruption, and then overwhelm your opponent with a powerful graveyard-based combo.

This Modern Aggro - Affinity deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and maximizing card advantage through Thought Monitor and Thoughtcast. The key strategy involves utilizing Urza, Lord High Artificer to generate mana and create a board presence while disrupting opponents with Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes artifact synergies with Ingenious Smith and Nettlecyst, as well as interaction through Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole. Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key artifacts and support the aggressive game plan, while the land base enables consistent mana production and fixing.

The deck focuses on assembling pieces quickly to create a powerful combo using Tameshi, Reality Architect. It includes various cards that allow for tutoring, ramping, and fixing mana, such as Lotus Bloom, Eladamri's Call, and Wargate. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to protect the combo and control opponents. Other creatures like Cultivator Colossus and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide additional value and utility. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the combo and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure on the opponent. With a suite of efficient removal and disruption spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the board while maintaining a fast tempo. The inclusion of cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Consider helps maintain card advantage and find key pieces. The deck's versatile mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while maximizing utility.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through cards quickly to fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield. This combo allows the player to overwhelm their opponent with a sudden influx of creatures, potentially leading to a quick victory. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Negation to protect the combo and Boseiju, Who Endures to make sure the combo resolves without any interference. Overall, the key strategy is to set up the Living End combo efficiently and effectively.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an aggressive strategy, using artifacts to quickly deploy threats and pump them up with equipment like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear. The key concept is to flood the board with cheap artifact creatures like Frogmite and Ornithopter, supported by efficient card draw from Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor. Efficient mana production from cards like Springleaf Drum and Urza's Saga helps to power out threats quickly and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of graveyard hate like Relic of Progenitus helps to disrupt opponents' game plans and secure victory for the aggressive Affinity archetype.

The deck focuses on utilizing cycling creatures and cascade spells to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures. By casting cascade spells like Violent Outburst, the deck can then cast Living End to bring all creatures back onto the battlefield, often overwhelming the opponent with a large board presence. The deck also includes disruption spells like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to deal damage as fast as possible by utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with direct damage spells like Lava Spike and Lightning Bolt. Cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel punish opponents for playing spells, adding an extra layer of pressure. The mana base is optimized for consistent red mana sources to ensure the deck can cast its spells on curve and maintain a relentless assault.

The deck focuses on ramping quickly to play powerful lands and creatures like Primeval Titan, with the goal of creating an unbeatable board state that overwhelms the opponent. Cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help to accelerate the mana production, while lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle provide extra value. The main win condition is to use Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands and set up lethal attacks. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and dominate the game with overwhelming board presence.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient threats and disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to apply pressure early with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while maintaining tempo with cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. It also leverages card advantage with spells like Expressive Iteration and Snapcaster Mage. The mana base is streamlined to support the low curve and enable easy access to both blue and red spells. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or outvalue the deck.

This deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, countermagic, and card advantage to control the game. It utilizes powerful multicolored cards like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and out-value the opponent. The deck also includes various creatures for defense and to pressure the opponent, while also incorporating some ramp and consistency cards like Abundant Growth and Expressive Iteration. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays, while also utilizing the Cascade mechanic to generate additional value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Crashing Footfalls, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Force of Negation and Blood Moon. By combining aggressive creatures with powerful Cascade spells like Violent Outburst, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game until victory. Additionally, the deck includes versatile spells like Fire / Ice and Prismari Command to provide additional flexibility in different matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Sakura-Tribe Elder and Explore to get to 6 lands in play as soon as possible. Once Primeval Titan hits the battlefield, it can search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and mountains to deal damage with its triggered ability. Cards like Wrenn and Six and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help with land recursion and fixing mana. The goal is to assemble the Valakut combo to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent in a single turn.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, removal, and card advantage. By leveraging cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six along with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to control the board state and outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility, while the land base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements and toolbox options.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful Elemental creatures and disruptive spells. Using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler, Wrenn and Six, and Prismatic Ending to control the board and slow down opponents, while also generating card advantage and value with cards like Risen Reef and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck aims to outvalue opponents with powerful Elemental synergies and versatile removal spells, ultimately winning through overwhelming board presence and control of the game's tempo.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Heliod/Spike Feeder combo to gain infinite life and create infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures. By using cards like Collected Company and Ranger-Captain of Eos to search for combo pieces, the deck aims to establish a powerful board presence while staying resilient against disruption. Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf help ramp into the combo quickly, while Auriok Champion provides protection and lifegain. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Skyclave Apparition and Voice of Resurgence to control the board and protect the combo.
